# Thinking China: Chinese tech giants' struggle to power AI data centre boom

**Traced to: [27] Caixin Global (in-depth)**

This is a republication/summary of the Caixin Global article (source 27). Not an independent source.

## Key Figures (from the Caixin original)
- 2024: China data centers consumed ~**140 billion kWh**, up **31% YoY** (vs 6.8% growth in total power consumption). Source: Han Bing, S&P Global Commodity Insights.
- By 2030: could reach **400 billion kWh**, raising data centers' share from <2% to **6%** of national power consumption. Source: CAICT.
- Intelligent computing centres ("AI brain factories"): **20-130 kW per server cabinet** vs 5-10 kW for traditional cloud. Source: Li Jinbo, IEIT Systems.
- China intelligent computing scale expected to grow **33.9% annually** 2022-2027 (IDC).
- NDRC/MIIT + 2 agencies released low-carbon development plan for data centers (Jul 2024).

## Assessment
- `authoritative: no` — ThinkChina is an aggregator/republication platform, not a primary source.
- All load-bearing figures trace to Caixin Global (source 27) and the analysts cited therein.
